chunks.title: Vellore Citizens' Welfare Forum v. Union of India, (1996) 5 SCC 647
chunks.content:
### Vellore Citizens' Welfare Forum v. Union of India, (1996) 5 SCC 647
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (Kuldip Singh, J.)
**Core Holding:** Integrated the "Precautionary Principle" and the "Polluter Pays Principle" as essential features of sustainable development and part of the environmental law of the land under Article 21.

chunks.title: M.C. Mehta v. Union of India (Oleum Gas Leak), (1987) 1 SCC 395
chunks.content:
### M.C. Mehta v. Union of India (Oleum Gas Leak), (1987) 1 SCC 395
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (P.N. Bhagwati, CJI)
**Core Holding:** Propounded the doctrine of "Absolute Liability" for enterprises engaged in hazardous or inherently dangerous activities, rejecting exceptions to strict liability under Rylands v. Fletcher.

chunks.title: Limitation & Expert Committee Procedure
chunks.content:
### Limitation & Expert Committee Procedure
1. **Limitation under Section 14 NGT Act:** 6 months from the date on which the cause of action first arose, extendable by max 60 days on sufficient cause.
2. **Joint Expert Committees:** Standard practice of NGT appointing multi-disciplinary expert committees (CPCB, SPCB, MoEFCC) for ground-truthing environmental damage.

chunks.title: Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 (EPA)
chunks.content:
### Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 (EPA)
- **Section 3 & 5:** Powers of Central Government to take measures for protecting and improving the environment and issue binding closure/stoppage directions.
- **EIA Notification 2006:** Mandatory prior environmental clearance for category A and B industrial and infrastructure projects.

chunks.title: National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 (NGT Act)
chunks.content:
### National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 (NGT Act)
- **Section 14 & 15:** Jurisdiction over civil environmental cases arising out of implementation of enactments; power to grant relief, compensation, and restitution of damaged property and environment.
- **Section 20:** Mandatory application of Sustainable Development, Precautionary Principle, and Polluter Pays Principle by the Tribunal.
